title: Projects
text: Below is a selection of projects completed during my training, internships, and personal development. These projects reflect my profile as a Full‑Stack Developer with strong QA / Testing expertise, focusing on real use cases, clean structure, and software quality.

projects.title: 1.AY&EM Edu – Digital Education Platform
projects.description: A digital educational content marketplace designed with role-based access control. The platform provides students with a secure, fast, and convenient way to access educational materials and learning resources.
keyFuture: Authors and educators can upload and sell their PDF books.
Students and readers can purchase digital books using secure payment methods.
Students can take purchased exams and practice tests online and view detailed performance analytics.
Access purchased digital books and educational resources anytime, anywhere.

projects.title: 2.Edulien – Educational Management Platform
projects.description: A platform designed for class management with a role‑based access control system.
keyFuture: Teachers can create and manage classes
Students can be added via email

projects.title: 3.Musa Yalçın – Personal Portfolio
projects.description: A modern, fast, and multilingual personal portfolio built with Next.js, MUI Material, and i18n. Designed to showcase my projects, experience, and technical skills through a clean and professional interface.

projects.title: 4.Erdil Çalış – Law Office
projects.description: A modern, fast, and SEO‑focused corporate website built for Erdil Çalış. It provides a professional digital identity with a minimalist design, strong content management, and a user‑friendly interface.

projects.title: 5.CodeurFreelance – Showcase Website
projects.description: IFrontend-only showcase website with modern, responsive, and multilingual interface. Developed as part of a team during internship.
